rationale: The source and blind translation visibly agree on the main psi_2 upper-bound shape: one positive universal constant, the standard centered Gaussian case, the centered sigma-dependent case, and linear C sigma scaling. Because those issues affect both implication directions and cannot be resolved using only the permitted round-trip evidence, the round-trip judgment is undetermined and requires adjudication.
